[Unit]
Description=Recover TV display after HDMI hotplug blackscreen
# Run after the compositor is up, but before we need the display
After=graphical-session.target
PartOf=graphical-session.target
# Only run in graphical sessions
ConditionEnvironment=WAYLAND_DISPLAY

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/home/test/.local/bin/recover-tv-display.sh
# Don't restart automatically — hotplug events are handled by the udev trigger below
RemainAfterExit=no

[Install]
WantedBy=graphical-session.target
